subject: hep-th
title_original: The Triple $T\bar{T}$-Like Flow in Quantum Field Theories: Irrelevant, Marginal, and Relevant
authors: H. Babaei-Aghbolagh, Bin Chen, Song He, Jue Hou
abstract: We introduce a one-parameter root-$T\bar T$-like flow, $ \partial_λ\mathcal{L}=\mathcal{R}_λ^{1/α}$, which organizes stress-tensor deformations into irrelevant, marginal, and relevant branches. Within duality-invariant electrodynamics in four dimensions, and equivalently within two-dimensional integrable sigma models, the flow admits a closed-form solution controlled by an auxiliary equation. The marginal point $α=1$ reproduces the root-$T\bar T$ / ModMax branch, while $α 1$, the same construction yields explicit relevant $T\bar T$-like Lagrangians. These results suggest that root-$T\bar T$ flows provide a common organizing principle for duality-invariant and integrable deformations.
title_relatable: How stress-energy deformations reshape quantum field theories
hook: A unified mathematical framework connects three types of field theory deformations—from trivial to dominant—through a single adjustable flow, with exact solutions in electromagnetism and integrable systems.
summary: Researchers found a one-parameter family of stress-tensor deformations that unifies three regimes: irrelevant (vanish at high energy), marginal (no energy scale), and relevant (dominate physics). In four-dimensional electromagnetism and 2D integrable models, they solved the equations exactly, revealing that the marginal case recovers a known symmetry-preserving deformation. The framework suggests a deep organizing principle behind duality-invariant quantum field theories.
